ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

fsm_hints.rule: Source MUST NOT wait for READY before asserting VALID. Destination MAY wait for VALID before asserting READY. Once VALID is asserted it must remain asserted until the handshake cycle (rising ACLK with both VALID and READY HIGH).

channel_dependency_rules_AXI4_AXI5_write.note: AXI4/AXI5 add an additional slave dependency on AW handshake before BVALID, so slaves take fewer buffering decisions independent of the address.

write_transaction_fsm_master: Drive AWADDR + AW* fields; assert AWVALID.
Drive WDATA + WSTRB + WLAST per beat; assert WVALID.
Wait for AWREADY and WREADY handshakes per channel.
Assert BREADY to complete write response.
read_transaction_fsm_master: Drive ARADDR + AR* fields; assert ARVALID.
Sample RDATA + RRESP per beat when RVALID HIGH.
Assert RREADY each beat until RLAST observed.
exit_from_reset: earliest point after reset that a master is permitted to begin driving ARVALID, AWVALID, or WVALID HIGH is at a rising ACLK edge after ARESETn is HIGH.

default_ready_state_recommendation.AWREADY: Default HIGH recommended (slave must accept any valid address in one cycle).
default_ready_state_recommendation.WREADY: May default HIGH only if slave can always accept write data in one cycle.
default_ready_state_recommendation.BREADY: May default HIGH only if master can always accept a write response in one cycle.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RREADY: May default HIGH only if master can accept read data immediately at start of read.

anti_deadlock_rule: Inside the slave, VALID for an outgoing channel must not be combinationally dependent on the READY of the same channel; this prevents combinational deadlock.

fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)

per_channel_states: HANDSHAKE (VALID=1, READY=1 on rising ACLK -> transfer occurs)
fsm_hints_inherited_from_axi.rule: Source MUST NOT wait for READY before asserting VALID.

ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_match_memory: UC and SC have data matching main memory.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_dirty: UD and SD differ from memory; cache owns write-back.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_unique: UC and UD are uniquely held by this cache.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.rule_shared: SC and SD may also be held by other caches.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.store_visibility: Stores to UC/UD visible immediately. Stores to SC/SD require a CleanUnique/MakeUnique broadcast first.
ace_cache_line_fsm_5_state.invalid_rule: An Invalid line is not present in this cache.

ace_cache_line_transitions.ReadShared_into_empty: I -> SC / SD / UC / UD per RRESP[3:2]
ace_cache_line_transitions.ReadClean_into_empty: I -> SC or UC (PassDirty must be 0)
ace_cache_line_transitions.CleanShared_local: UD -> SC (write back) / UC -> SC / SD -> SC

ace_per_transaction_master_fsm: Master drives AR* with ARDOMAIN/ARSNOOP/ARBAR; asserts ARVALID.
If coherent: interconnect snoops other caches in parallel.
Interconnect drives R beats with RDATA + RRESP[3:0].
Master asserts RREADY per beat; final beat has RLAST=1.
Master pulses RACK one cycle after RLAST handshake.
Install line in cache per (RRESP[3:2], ARSNOOP).
ace_per_transaction_snoop_target_fsm: Interconnect drives ACVALID + ACADDR + ACSNOOP + ACPROT.
Cached master asserts ACREADY (may default HIGH).
Once ACVALID + ACREADY both HIGH, master begins snoop processing.
Master determines cache hit/miss + transition per ACSNOOP.
Master drives CRRESP[4:0] and asserts CRVALID.
If DataTransfer=1: master drives CDDATA beats with CDLAST.
Wait for CRREADY (and CDREADY per beat) handshakes.
Apply state transition per Table C5-4.
fields.snoop_channel_dependency_rule: Master must wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY to be asserted before asserting CRVALID. Master must also wait for both ACVALID and ACREADY before asserting CDVALID. CRVALID/CDVALID must not depend combinationally on CRREADY/CDREADY.

rack_wack_fsm.RACK: Single-cycle pulse one ACLK after RLAST+RVALID+RREADY.
rack_wack_fsm.WACK: Single-cycle pulse one ACLK after BVALID+BREADY.
rack_wack_fsm.purpose: Tell the interconnect that the response is committed so subsequent snoops can be safely ordered.

dvm_message_phases: Phase 1: initiator broadcasts DVMMessage via AC to all DVM nodes.
Phase 2: each target invalidates the indicated entry and responds on CR.
Phase 3: initiator issues DVMComplete; aggregated sync done.
fields.anti_deadlock_rule: Inside the master, VALID for an outgoing AC/CR/CD channel must not be combinationally dependent on the READY of an incoming channel. Inside the interconnect, snoop dispatch must not wait for downstream snoop response combinationally.
fields.exit_from_reset: Earliest VALID HIGH = rising ACLK after ARESETn=HIGH. Interconnect may drive ACVALID HIGH only once it has snoop work to do.

default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.ACREADY: Default HIGH recommended — accept snoops quickly.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.CDREADY: May default HIGH if interconnect can absorb data.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.WREADY: May default HIGH if slave can accept W in one cycle.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.BREADY: May default HIGH if master can accept B in one cycle.
default_ready_state_recommendation_ace.RREADY: May default HIGH if master can accept R immediately.
